propertySets.name: Pset_CommunicationsApplianceTypeTelecommand
propertySets.definition: Properties common to a telecommand. This property set is applied to a type or occurrence of IfcCommunicationsAppliance with predefined type TELECOMMAND.

properties.name: NumberOfWorkstations
properties.definition: Indicates the types or purposes of workstations and their number in the equipment. The defined purpose can be e.g. 'Diagnostic and maintenance', 'Traffic and electric traction', etc.

properties.name: NumberOfCPUs
properties.definition: The number of CPUs used by the equipment.
